| notes =  '''Offers General Information:'''
:You seem lost, recruit. Tell me if there's anything you wish to know?
:*"''Nothing in particular.''"
:*"''I want to go out and fight!''": Just arrived and you're already aching to leave, eh? Listen, the land is wild beyond our gates, filled with fiends and their ilk. If you must go outside, head through Ranperre Gate. Allow me to explain. Right now we're on the Parade Grounds. Find the gate to the west. Step through and pass the furniture store and the inn. Take the gate on the left. Make another left down the stairs. You'll see Ranperre Gate beyond. Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
:*"''I want to go shopping.''": For weapons and basic supplies, take a walk through the city and you'll find all that you need. Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
:*"''I want to know more about adventuring.''": Recruits... Don't know which way to hold a sword and you think you're ready. Well, what would you like to know?
::*"''Helping people.''": Ah, a commendable choice! I saw a lady in front of a house on Pikeman's Way who may be in need of assistance. Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
::*"''Hunting monsters.''": Novices... Don't know your own limits until a fiend beats it into your head for you. Very well. How about gathering some hides for the Tanners' Guild in Southern San d'Oria? Southern San d'Oria is just beyond Victory Arch there. Pass through and go west. You'll find the Tanners' Guild soon enough. Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
::*"''Making easy money.''": Easy money, eh? Typical! I canot promise ease, but check the lumberyard on Laborman's Way. They shuld have some work for you. Go through the gate to the west and pass the Phoenix Perch Inn. You should see another gate there to your right. That gate leads to Laborman's Way. Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
::*"''Working for my country.''": Ah, a commendable choice. Each enterance to the city has a gatehouse. Tell the guards there you wish to work for tthe glory of the kingdom! Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
| historicalbackground =  
}}

{{NPC | image = Oboro.png | name = Oboro | gender = Male | race = Hume | job = | occupation = Weaponsmith | affiliation = Jeuno | status = | type = NPC | location = {{Location|Port Jeuno|E-6}} | starts missions = | starts quests = | involved in missions = | involved in quests = | notes = This [[:category:NPCs|NPC]] manages player transactions related to upgrading [[Relic Weapon]] [[Mythic Weapon]] and [[Empyrean Weapons]] to Item Level:119. He also will craft Job Specific weapons for players he deems worthy. }} ==Upgrading REM== In a style similar to that of the [[Trial of the Magians]], Oboro will upgrade your [[Relic Weapon]], [[Mythic Weapon]], or [[Empyrean Weapons]] from level 99 to Item Level:119. *You must have the level 99 R/E/M weapon equipped and have fulfilled at least ''one'' of the below requirements before he will talk to you about upgrading it. **Completion of any SKCNM 20 on "Difficult" or higher setting. **Completion of any [[High-Tier Mission Battlefields]] fight on "Normal" or higher setting. **Obtained the title from defeating any of the [[Delve]] megabosses. **Clear any Intense Ambuscade. **Clear any Regular [[Ambuscade]] on Normal difficulty or higher. After speaking with Oboro with the 99 weapon equipped and having fulfilled one of his requirements, you will get additional text. He will ask you to come back to him with the weapon and state the price for his services; he will ask for 300 [[Pluton]]s, [[Beitetsu]], or [[Riftborn Boulder]]s. The currency required is dependent on the type of weapon with which you spoke to him. After trading him the appropriate currency with the weapon being upgraded, he will ask you to wait one game day. *300 [[Pluton]]s for [[Relic Weapon]] *300 [[Beitetsu]] for [[Mythic Weapon]] *300 [[Riftborn Boulder]]s for [[Empyrean Weapons]]
==Final REMA/REME 119 Stage III Upgrade== *You must obtain the Key Item: [[Scintillating Rhapsody]] from the final Rhapsodies of Vana'diel Mission first, before you are able to start this process. *Trade the Item Level:119 weapon to Oboro to begin the process. *Multiple weapons may not be reforged at once, unless the current one is either completed or abandoned. *The process may be canceled at any time, but any materials you have traded will not be returned. *Trade the required items to Oboro: **10000 [[Pluton]]s are required for Relic Weapons 119 "I" variants. ***119 "II" variants possessing an Afterglow only require 1. **10000 [[Riftborn Boulder]]s are required for Empyrean Weapons 119 "I" variants. ***119 "II" variants possessing an Afterglow only require 1. **10000 [[Beitetsu]] are required for Mythic Weapons and Ergon Weapons 119 "I" variants. ***119 "II" variants possessing an Afterglow only require 1. **Aeonic weapons are rewarded at this stage already and don't need to be upgraded. *Trade the iLevel 119 weapon to Oboro again after trading the required amount of stones. *After one game day, he will provide you with the completed final form Item Level:119 "III" weapon.
==Augmenting REMA Weapons== *After you unlock [[:Category:Dynamis-Divergence|Dynamis-Divergence]], Oboro can augment your stage III Relic, Empyrean, Mythic, and Aeonic weapons. **In order to upgrade a weapon, you need to earn a corresponding key item: ***Relic weapons require [[Tarutaru Mask of Light]], which is earned in Windurst. ***Mythic weapons require [[Galka Mask of Light]], which is earned in Bastok. ***Empyrean weapons require [[Elvaan Mask of Light]], which is earned in San d'Oria. ***Aeonic weapons require [[Mithra Mask of Light]], which is earned in Jeuno. **There are three different ways to earn a mask: ***Defeat the zone's wave 3 boss (Disjoined [Race]). ***Deal a cumulative 30 million damage to the wave 3 boss. The boss has 20 million HP, so you need to fight the boss at least twice to earn it this way. ***Trade 10,000 total Job Points. You can trade up to 700 per [[Japanese Midnight|Conquest Tally]], which means it takes minimum fifteen weeks. You must have a stage III weapon equipped as a mastered job to start trading Job Points for its type. Once you've started, you can trade Job Points from any mastered job regardless if it can use the weapon or not. **You are not locked into a path once you start. Any Job Points you spent aren't refunded if you earn the mask from Dynamis-Divergence. **The key items are permanent and you can augment as many weapons of its type as you want. *Once you've gotten a mask, trade a corresponding stage III weapon and a [[Swart Astral Detritus]] to augment the weapon. After you've started, trade the weapon and a collection of [[Swart Astral Detritus]] (10 RP each) or [[Murky Astral Detritus]] (50 RP each) to raise the rank. **Weapons have one upgrade path that raises the base damage, gives a flat damage bonus to its signature weapon skill up to +10%, and raises a pair of stats (e.g. up to DEX/AGI+20 for [[Twashtar]]). Rank 15 is the current maximum rank. **When you augment a ranged weapon, Oboro also gives you a belt that dispenses its signature ammunition. This is due to programming limits that prevent an item from being simultaneously augmented and dispensing.
==JSE Weapons== In his usual rude manner, Oboro will also make a variety of Job Specific Weapons. The items required vary from weapon to weapon. Each weapon will typically require two specific crafted weapons, a [[Cehuetzi Pelt]] or [[Cehuetzi Claw]], and your choice of 150 [[Pluton]]s, [[Beitetsu]], or [[Riftborn Boulder]]s. After trading the appropriate items he will ask you to wait one game day. *You must fulfill at least ''one'' of the below requirements before he will consent to craft a weapon for you. **Completion of any SKCNM 20 on "Difficult" or higher setting. **Completion of any High Tier Battlefield fight on "Normal" or higher setting. **Obtained the title from defeating any of the Delve megabosses. **Clear any Intense Ambuscade. **Clear any Regular Ambuscade on Normal difficulty or higher. * [[Minos]] Great Axe, Warrior * [[Nyepel]] Hand-to-Hand, Monk * [[Sindri]] Club, White Mage * [[Kaladanda]] Staff, Black Mage * [[Egeking]] Sword, Red Mage * [[Sandung]] Dagger, Thief * [[Priwen]] Shield, Paladin * [[Cronus]] Scythe, Dark Knight * [[Arktoi]] Axe, Beast Master * [[Terpander]] String Instrument, Bard * [[Lionsquall]] Gun, Ranger * [[Kurikaranotachi]] Great Katana, Samurai * [[Shigi]] Katana, Ninja * [[Areadbhar]] Polearm, Dragoon * [[Gridarvor]] Staff, Summoner * [[Mimesis]] Sword, Blue Mage * [[Deathlocke]] Gun, Corsair * [[Ohtas]] Hand-to-Hand, Puppetmaster * [[Polyhymnia]] Dagger, Dancer * [[Coeus]] Staff, Scholar * [[Dunna]] Handbell, Geomancer * [[Aettir]] Great Sword, Runefencer == Augmenting JSE Weapons == Job-specific weapons crafted by Oboro may receive augments. The attributes thereof are pre-determined by the weapon. An applicable weapon and the [[Scintillating Rhapsody|scintillating rhapsody]] key item are required to enhance these weapons. == Dynamis-Divergence Crafted Equipment == Job specific weapons and neck pieces crafted using Dynamis-Divergence items can be augmented. * To start the augment process, trade the item to Oboro and choose a path. ** There are three quality tiers that determine the maximum augment rank. 15 for normal, 20 for HQ1, and 25 for HQ2. ** Neck pieces have one augment path while weapons have three: *** Path A: Chance of double damage +30%/40%/50%, Store TP +15/20/25, DMG+ (varies) *** Path B: Chance of follow-up attack +30%/40%/50%, Subtle Blow II +15/20/25, DMG+ (varies) *** Path C: Enhancements to two or three job specific traits, some weapons also have DMG+ (varies) * To earn RP, either wear it in [[Dynamis-Divergence]] while killing monsters or trade the item alongside [[Heroism Crystal]]s (10 TP) or [[Heroism Aggregate]] (50 RP). Dynamis monsters give the following amounts: ** Wave 1: 10 per normal, 20 per leader ** Wave 2: 20 per normal, 40 per leader ** Wave 3: 30 per normal, 50 per leader
